narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed during the afternoon hours in a warm and humid airmass in place across the Ohio Valley.
ev: High water was reported on several roadways.
One to two feet of water was flowing across the roadway near the intersection of Hochwalt Avenue and South Broadway Street.
A few motorists were stranded in high water near downtown Dayton.
